description: This file defines a custom form type named YearType that extends a TextType class within a Symfony-based form handling system. It customizes the year input field by setting default minimum and maximum year values and managing display options such as CSS classes and addons.

classes.name: YearType
classes.description: A custom form type extending TextType to represent a year input field, with specific configuration for min/max year and display options.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the YearType, including min and max years based on the current year, and visual configuration options.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Builds the form view by assigning custom options to the view's variables for rendering.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for this form block type, used during form rendering.
